title: Verschränkung in Vielteilchensystemen (TUM, Modul NAT5018m)
description:
Within the seminar " Entanglement in Many-Body System,” students present and discuss topics at the intersection of condensed matter physics and quantum information. The content of the seminar is focussed on the following topics: - Measures of Entanglement - An Area Law for One Dimensional Quantum Systems - Matrix product state representations - Topological entanglement entropy - Computable measures of entanglement - Detecting Topological Order at Finite Temperature Using Entanglement Negativity - Entanglement Spectrum as a Generalization of Entanglement Entropy - Entanglement Spectrum of a topological phase in one dimension - Entanglement entropy and conformal field theory

**Voraussetzungen / Prerequisites:**
Fundamental quantum mechanics, basics of quantum many-body theory
